mapper.sql: D.doc_seq AS "docSeq", D.office_seq AS "officeSeq", D.form_template_seq AS "formTemplateSeq", FT.template_name AS "formTemplateName", D.doc_no AS "docNo", D.doc_title AS "docTitle", D.doc_status AS "docStatus", D.drafter_seq AS "drafterSeq", UI.user_name_ko AS "drafterName", D.draft_dept_seq AS "draftDeptSeq", DP.dept_name AS "draftDeptName", D.submit_at AS "submitAt", D.complete_at AS "completeAt", D.create_user AS "createUser", D.create_at AS "createAt", D.update_user AS "updateUser", D.update_at AS "updateAt"

LEFT JOIN utb_form_template FT ON D.form_template_seq = FT.form_template_seq AND FT.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN utb_user_info UI ON D.drafter_seq = UI.user_mst_seq AND UI.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN utb_dept_mst DP ON D.draft_dept_seq = DP.dept_seq AND DP.del_yn = 'N'
mapper.select:
SELECT , D.doc_content AS "docContent", FT.template_data AS "templateData" FROM utb_appr_doc D
WHERE D.doc_seq = #{docSeq} AND D.del_yn = 'N'

SELECT FROM utb_appr_doc D
WHERE D.drafter_seq = #{drafterSeq} AND D.del_yn = 'N'
AND D.doc_status = #{docStatus}
AND (D.doc_title ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR D.doc_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY D.create_at DESC

WITH current_steps AS ( SELECT L.doc_seq, MIN(CAST(L.step_order AS INT)) AS current_step FROM utb_appr_doc_line L WHERE L.del_yn = 'N' AND L.line_status = 'PENDING' GROUP BY L.doc_seq ) SELECT DISTINCT FROM utb_appr_doc D
JOIN current_steps CS ON D.doc_seq = CS.doc_seq JOIN utb_appr_doc_line L ON D.doc_seq = L.doc_seq AND CAST(L.step_order AS INT) = CS.current_step AND L.approver_seq = #{approverSeq} AND L.line_status = 'PENDING' AND L.del_yn = 'N' WHERE D.doc_status = 'PENDING' AND D.del_yn = 'N'
AND (D.doc_title ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR D.doc_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY D.submit_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT FROM utb_appr_doc D
WHERE D.del_yn = 'N' AND D.doc_status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED') AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM utb_appr_doc_target TG WHERE TG.doc_seq = D.doc_seq AND TG.target_role = 'SHARE' AND TG.target_type = 'EMPLOYEE' AND TG.ref_seq = #{userMstSeq} AND TG.del_yn = 'N' ) OR (FT.share_scope = 'ALL' AND D.office_seq = #{officeSeq}) )
AND (D.doc_title ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR D.doc_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY D.submit_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT FROM utb_appr_doc D
JOIN utb_appr_doc_target TG ON D.doc_seq = TG.doc_seq AND TG.target_role = 'RECEIVE' AND TG.target_type = 'DEPT' AND TG.del_yn = 'N' JOIN utb_office_employee OE ON TG.ref_seq = OE.dept_seq AND OE.user_mst_seq = #{userMstSeq} AND OE.del_yn = 'N' WHERE D.del_yn = 'N' AND D.doc_status = 'APPROVED'
AND (D.doc_title ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR D.doc_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY D.complete_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT FROM utb_appr_doc D
WHERE D.del_yn = 'N' AND D.doc_status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED') AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM utb_appr_doc_target TG JOIN utb_office_employee OE ON TG.ref_seq = OE.dept_seq AND OE.del_yn = 'N' WHERE TG.doc_seq = D.doc_seq AND TG.target_role = 'SHARE' AND TG.target_type = 'DEPT' AND OE.user_mst_seq = #{userMstSeq} AND TG.del_yn = 'N' ) OR (FT.share_scope = 'ALL' AND D.office_seq = #{officeSeq}) )
AND (D.doc_title ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR D.doc_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY D.submit_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT FROM utb_appr_doc D
JOIN utb_appr_doc_target TG ON D.doc_seq = TG.doc_seq AND TG.target_role = 'RECEIVE' AND TG.target_type = 'EMPLOYEE' AND TG.ref_seq = #{userMstSeq} AND TG.del_yn = 'N' WHERE D.del_yn = 'N' AND D.doc_status = 'APPROVED'
AND (D.doc_title ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR D.doc_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY D.complete_at DESC

SELECT fn_get_dynamic_seq('utb_appr_doc')
INSERT INTO utb_appr_doc ( doc_seq, office_seq, form_template_seq, doc_no, doc_title, doc_content, doc_status, drafter_seq, draft_dept_seq, submit_at, create_user, create_at, update_user, update_at, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{docSeq}, #{officeSeq}, #{formTemplateSeq}, #{docNo}, #{docTitle}, #{docContent}, #{docStatus}, #{drafterSeq}, COALESCE(#{draftDeptSeq}, (SELECT dept_seq FROM utb_office_employee WHERE user_mst_seq = #{drafterSeq} AND del_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1)), #{submitAt}, #{createUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updateUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'N' )
mapper.update:
UPDATE utb_appr_doc
doc_title = #{docTitle}, doc_content = #{docContent}, doc_status = #{docStatus}, submit_at = #{submitAt}, complete_at = #{completeAt}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE doc_seq = #{docSeq} AND del_yn = 'N'

SELECT fn_get_dynamic_seq('utb_appr_doc_line')
INSERT INTO utb_appr_doc_line ( line_seq, doc_seq, step_order, step_name, step_type, approver_seq, approver_name, approver_type, line_status, create_user, create_at, update_user, update_at, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{lineSeq}, #{docSeq}, #{stepOrder}, #{stepName}, #{stepType}, #{approverSeq}, #{approverName}, #{approverType}, 'PENDING', #{createUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updateUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT L.line_seq AS "lineSeq", L.doc_seq AS "docSeq", L.step_order AS "stepOrder", L.step_name AS "stepName", L.step_type AS "stepType", L.approver_seq AS "approverSeq", COALESCE(L.approver_name, UI.user_name_ko) AS "approverName", L.approver_type AS "approverType", L.line_status AS "lineStatus", L.action_at AS "actionAt", L.action_comment AS "actionComment" FROM utb_appr_doc_line L LEFT JOIN utb_user_info UI ON L.approver_seq = UI.user_mst_seq AND UI.del_yn = 'N' WHERE L.doc_seq = #{docSeq} AND L.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY CAST(L.step_order AS INT) ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE utb_appr_doc_line SET line_status = #{lineStatus}, action_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, action_comment = #{actionComment}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE line_seq = #{lineSeq}

INSERT INTO utb_appr_doc_target ( target_seq, doc_seq, target_role, target_type, ref_seq, create_user, create_at, update_user, update_at, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{targetSeq}, #{docSeq}, #{targetRole}, #{targetType}, #{refSeq}, #{createUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updateUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT T.target_seq AS "targetSeq", T.doc_seq AS "docSeq", T.target_role AS "targetRole", T.target_type AS "targetType", T.ref_seq AS "refSeq", COALESCE(UI.user_name_ko, DP.dept_name) AS "refName" FROM utb_appr_doc_target T LEFT JOIN utb_user_info UI ON T.target_type = 'EMPLOYEE' AND (T.ref_seq = UI.user_mst_seq OR T.ref_seq = UI.user_info_seq) AND UI.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN utb_dept_mst DP ON T.target_type = 'DEPT' AND T.ref_seq = DP.dept_seq AND DP.del_yn = 'N' WHERE T.doc_seq = #{docSeq} AND T.del_yn = 'N'
